policy.development: The existing 12-question set has been repeatedly inspected during lexical, semantic, hybrid and reranker development. It may be used for diagnostics and future design work but must not be described as held-out.
policy.heldout: The new 12-question set was manually judged and frozen before any retriever or reranker was run on it. After the first held-out measurement, it must not be used to tune configuration without creating a new independent test set.
